entities.summary: Michael McLeod is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for Avangard Omsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the New Jersey Devils of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the first round, 12th overall, of the 2016 NHL entry draft. He made his NHL debut for the Devils during the 2019–20 NHL season and spent the next five years with New Jersey. His career in North America was put on hold in 2024 when he was named in the 2018 Hockey Canada controversy and sexual assault, causing him to leave the NHL for the KHL.
